text:
Predicates:
SupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is a supervised learning algorithm.
UnsupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is an unsupervised learning algorithm.
ReinforcementLearning(x) ::: x is a reinforcement learning algorithm.
Trains(x, y) ::: x trains y.
RequiresLabelledData(x) ::: x requires labelled data.
Model(y) ::: y is a model.
StateOfTheArt(y) ::: y is the state-of-the-art model.
TextSummarizationModel(y) ::: y is a text summarization model.
Premises:
∃x (UnsupervisedLearning(x) ∧ ¬RequiresLabelledData(x)) ::: Unsupervised learning doesn't require labelled data.
∃x (SupervisedLearning(x) ∧ Trains(x, textSummarizationModel)) ∧ StateOfTheArt(textSummarizationModel) ::: The state-of-the-art text summarization model is trained with machine learning algorithms.
¬∃x (ReinforcementLearning(x) ∧ Trains(x, textSummarizationModel)) ::: Reinforcement learning is not used to train the model.
∃x (MachineLearningAlgorithm(x) ∧ Trains(x, textSummarizationModel) ∧ RequiresLabelledData(x)) ::: The machine learning algorithm for training the model requires labelled data.
Conclusion:
∃x (SupervisedLearning(x) ∧ Trains(x, textSummarizationModel)) ::: Supervised learning is used to train the text summarization model.
